### Coord

Native unscaled galaxy-map coordinate; not a window pixel or distance in parsecs.

Constraints: `{"maximum": 32767, "minimum": -32768, "type": "integer", "x-integerToken": true}`.

### Count

Nonnegative integer count of authorized projected records only.

Constraints: `{"maximum": 2147483647, "minimum": 0, "type": "integer", "x-integerToken": true}`.

### Counter

Unsigned decimal string, monotonically increasing within its documented identity scope.

Constraints: `{"maxLength": 20, "minLength": 1, "pattern": "^(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*)(?![\\s\\S])", "type": "string", "x-maxDecimal": "18446744073709551615", "x-maxUtf8Bytes": 20, "x-minUtf8Bytes": 1}`.

### Credits

Whole displayed billion credits, not a hidden economic intermediate.

Constraints: `{"maximum": 2147483647, "minimum": -2147483648, "type": "integer", "x-integerToken": true}`.

## Field policies

Reviewed means static evidence, not runtime visibility approval.

| Policy | Status | Predicate | Native sources | Planned tests |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| contract | contract | Only copied protocol metadata or already authorized projected values; never read native memory here. |  | T-01, T-05, T-07, T-11 |
| request | contract | Caller-supplied intent only; exact typed validation, authorization and generation recheck before use. |  | T-04, T-08, T-11 |
| session | reviewed | Only the explicitly authorized local perspective. Omit game/perspective/revision/turn before a game is loaded and after revocation; publish committed turn only, not intermediate calculation. | src/game/mox2.cpp: thunk_main2; src/game/nextturn.cpp: Next_Turn; src/game/netturn.cpp: Client_Next_Turn; src/game/multplay.cpp: Hotseat_Select_Player | T-05, T-06 |
| systems-map | reviewed | Only systems whose native map position is drawn for this player. Coordinates are native star coordinates, before zoom/pan. ID assigned after this predicate; no slot-derived numbering. | src/game/mainscr.cpp: Print_Star_Names; src/game/mainscr.cpp: Get_Star_Draw_Coords | T-01, T-02 |
| system-name | reviewed | Player_Is_Omniscient(viewer), or valid star owner plus Contact_With_One_Colony, or Player_Has_Visited. Reproduce rendered outpost/lore formatting; otherwise unknown. Get_Star_Name is evidence, NOT a pure query helper: it changes font/zoom state and may allocate a bitmap. | src/game/mainscr.cpp: Get_Star_Name; src/game/harold.cpp: Contact_With_One_Colony; src/game/harold.cpp: Player_Has_Visited | T-01, T-02, T-03 |
| system-visited | reviewed | Only the bound player&#x27;s visited bit, never the complete bitmask. Does not grant planet/owner/special disclosure. | src/game/harold.cpp: Player_Has_Visited; src/game/mainscr.cpp: Get_Star_Name | T-01, T-02 |
| nebulas-map | disabled | Pending independent audit of nebula map drawing and coordinate conversion. No type, hidden star membership or art/cache pointers. | src/game/mainscr.cpp: nebula | T-01, T-02 |
| disabled-system-owner | disabled | Pending per-field review of Star_Owner, mixed owners, visited/contact/lore and outpost semantics. Raw star.owner forbidden. | src/game/harold.cpp: Star_Owner | T-01, T-02 |
| disabled-player | disabled | Pending active/contact/omniscience and field-specific own economy audit. No global player enumeration; own treasury does not authorize opponent treasury. | src/game/racescrn.cpp: Init_Race_Display_Data | T-01, T-02, T-03 |
| disabled-planet | disabled | Pending read-only equivalent of native explored-planet policy; do not invoke a mutable list builder. Orbit/name/type separately gated. | src/game/plntsum.cpp: Filter_Explored_Planets | T-01, T-02 |
| disabled-colony | disabled | Own live colony and individually audited native display values only; foreign intelligence is a separate policy. Population is displayed units, never an unaudited native scaled value. | src/game/colony_main.cpp: Colony_Screen | T-01, T-02, T-03 |
| disabled-ship | disabled | Pending pure detection policy extraction. Display-node identity and route/ETA conditions differ. No builder invocation, stale nodes, raw location, cargo, orders or enemy design dump. | src/game/shipstak.cpp: Remove_Non_Detected_Ships; src/game/ships.cpp: Do_Ship_Destination_Lines; src/game/ships.cpp: Print_Eta_On_Ship_Icon | T-01, T-02 |
| disabled-fleet | disabled | Group only already authorized ships; stable IDs must not be rebuilt stack indices. Destination/ETA separately filtered. | src/game/shipstak.cpp: Find_Ship_Stacks | T-01, T-02 |
| disabled-design | disabled | Own templates or actual active scan-authorized details; calculators must be audited for mutation before sharing. | src/game/design_main.cpp: Design_Screen; src/game/cmbtdrw1.cpp: Detailed_View_Ship | T-01, T-02, T-03 |
| disabled-leader | disabled | Only owned or actually offered/discovered leaders; no enumeration of generated/hidden hero slots. | src/game/officer.cpp: Officers_Screen; src/game/mainpups.cpp: Random_New_Officer_Popup | T-01, T-02 |
| disabled-report | disabled | Only copied player-authorized messages and authorized entity links. Never call a report display/consume operation as query. | src/game/report.cpp: Display_Report_Aux | T-01, T-03, T-06 |
| disabled-options | disabled | Only options actually offered to the local player by the owning context; no hidden eligibility/AI reaction oracle. | src/game/tech.cpp: Commit_Selected_Entry | T-01, T-03, T-08 |
| disabled-movement | disabled | Specified own live ships and known destinations; share audited read-only verdict logic, never mutate scratch/UI or expose hidden defenders. | src/game/shipmove.cpp: Ships_Try_To_Move_To | T-01, T-02, T-08 |
| disabled-research | disabled | Own progress/choices or allowlisted public reference only. Costs/progress units and enemy scan disclosure require separate audits; no enemy research arrays. | src/game/tech.cpp: Commit_Selected_Entry; src/game/science.cpp: Science_Room | T-01, T-02, T-03 |
| disabled-relations | disabled | Known contacts and own treaties/visible indicators only; native labels, not hidden exact AI attitudes. | src/game/racescrn.cpp: Draw_Race_Text | T-01, T-03 |
| disabled-intelligence | disabled | Own allocation/mission/pool as displayed; no opponent allocations or hidden spy internals. | src/game/racescrn.cpp: Init_Race_Display_Data | T-01, T-03 |

| disabled-view | disabled | Per-owner rendered title/lines/selection audit required. A process calculating a hidden event is not authorization to publish its text or arguments. | src/game/textbox.cpp: Do_Text_Box | T-01, T-03, T-04 |
| disabled-saves | disabled | Initialized local slot metadata only, both entry routes. No filename/path/save bytes or filesystem listing. | src/game/loadsave.cpp: Do_Load_Game_Popup; src/game/mainmenu.cpp: Main_Menu_Screen | T-03, T-05, T-14 |
| disabled-scores | disabled | Only initialized sorted native Hall of Fame table during its lifetime, both menu/end-game entry routes. | src/game/score.cpp: Hall_Of_Fame_Screen | T-03, T-04 |
| disabled-lobby | disabled | Native advertised sessions/current local lobby/chat; bounded copied text only. Queries do not pump networking or expose NETMOX state. | src/game/multplay.cpp: Choose_Multi_Network_Game_Screen; src/game/multplay.cpp: Chat_Box_Input_Loop | T-03, T-04, T-05 |
| disabled-combat | disabled | Active observed battle or retained observed result for the bound perspective; field-level scan/target policy and cleanup-before-result capture audit required. No unseen computed battles. | src/game/combinit.cpp: Tactical_Combat; src/game/cmbtdrw1.cpp: Detailed_View_Ship | T-01, T-02, T-09 |
| disabled-resource | disabled | Opaque allowlisted reference/current-view resource capability only; no arbitrary LBX entry or OS path. Check decoded and encoded caps before allocation. | src/game/vfs.cpp: namespace vfs | T-01, T-03, T-11, T-12 |
| disabled-frame | disabled | Atomic copied frame and matching palette captured by their owner at the same generation; service never reads presenter surface concurrently. | src/game/video.cpp: namespace video | T-01, T-10, T-16 |

## Provisional limits

These do not close the native maximum-game profiling gate.

- **status:** provisional-until-native-maximum-game-profile
- **inputBytes:** 65536
- **depth:** 32
- **requestIdBytes:** 64
- **connections:** 4
- **authenticationDeadlineMs:** 5000
- **pendingRequestsPerConnection:** 16
- **pendingRequestsGlobal:** 64
- **commandsPerGamePoll:** 8
- **gamePollBudgetUs:** 2000
- **minimumCaptureIntervalMs:** 100
- **outputBytesPerConnection:** 33554432
- **outputBytesGlobal:** 134217728
- **retainedSnapshotBytesGlobal:** 67108864
- **retainedOperationResultsPerController:** 256
- **resultRetentionMs:** 30000
- **orderedEventsPerSubscription:** 4096
- **overflow:** Reject before admission; coalesce only complete unsent state. Ordered-event overflow signals a gap or disconnect. Never rewrite partial output or silently discard operation results.
